title: Shift compatibility of the normalized rational projective-line unit and counit
statement: For the normalized rational projective-line unit and counit, after triangulated and commutative-shift structures are chosen on the two restricted functors, both component natural transformations commute with all shifts.

source.place: Exactness: shift compatibility of normalized unit and counit

proof_origin.place: Exactness: shift compatibility of normalized unit and counit

lean.statement:
theorem unitCounit_shift_compatibility (family : Family l Y)
    [triP : (CategoryTheory.localizingClosure
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (coefficient l c).X
        (ProjectiveLine Y))).IsTriangulated]
    [triY : (CategoryTheory.localizingClosure
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (coefficient l c).X Y)).IsTriangulated]
    [commF : (push l c k p hpl Y).CommShift ℤ]
    [commG : (exceptional l c k p hpl Y).CommShift ℤ] :
    NatTrans.CommShift (unitCounit l c k p hpl Y family).1 ℤ ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (unitCounit l c k p hpl Y family).2 ℤ
